errors.quote: The first $b+1\le K$ rounds then act on prefix bits singly, costing $O(TpdK)$.
errors.problem: The prefix rounds are not the first b+1 rounds. The paper processes h=ell-1 on the long axes first, then the qK chunk rounds h=ell-2,...,b, and only at the end the bottom positions h=b-1,...,0. So the prefix rounds are the first round (when long axes exist) and the last b rounds, and there are at most b+1 of them. The cost is unaffected.
d is not unconstrained. The paper requires a_d p^eps <= d <= b_d p^eps, d>=2, d*ell <= C_ell p and 1 <= K=floor(d^c) <= ell-1. The page's later step "(d-1)q=O(p/K)" depends on d*ell <= C_ell p.

errors.quote: The contraction $F^+_{\boldsymbol t}B^{-1}L^{-1}$ adds error below $\delta$
errors.problem: The exact contraction adds no error; it only keeps the propagated 2delta+eta from growing. The extra error below delta comes from the computed opposite procedure's own approximation bound applied to z~. The paper splits these two by the triangle inequality.
